input.description: evaluate(adr_bundle Mapping, repo_snapshot Mapping). Raw package rows drive some predicates and dependency checks, normalized bundle/snapshot drive projections; bundle selected rule status is checked only per row; explicit evaluationDate is used for waiver dates, never wall clock.

output.description: Rule predicates/codes: NO_PACKAGES if snapshot normalized packages empty. LIB_NOT_CORE_PORT if raw package classification=='lib' but shape!='core+port'; ADAPTER_NOT_ADAPTER_SHAPE if classification startswith 'adapter' and shape!='adapter'; ADAPTER_DEFINES_RULES if same adapter class and truthy definesRules. LIB_HIDDEN_CAPABILITY for intersection of lib capabilities with clock/credential-use/database-write/environment/exit-code/filesystem-read/filesystem-write/github-mutation/network/random/stderr/stdout/subprocess. LIB_DEPENDS_ON_ADAPTER for lib dependencies that resolve to adapter-class package; UNKNOWN_DEPENDENCY for any package dependency not in packageId set. SURFACE_NOT_ADAPTER if surface shape!='adapter'; SURFACE_AUTHORITY unless surface.authority is literal False. GENERATED_AUTHORITY unless snapshot.generated.authority is literal False; README_CONTRACT unless readme.authority is False, contractSource=='repo-governance', generatedBlock is True. MISSING_REPO_GOAL / MISSING_REPO_NO_GOAL; MISSING_PACKAGE_GOAL / MISSING_PACKAGE_NO_GOAL; MISSING_SURFACE_GOAL / MISSING_SURFACE_NO_GOAL on blank string or empty text-list. HIDDEN_INPUTS if normalized hiddenInputs nonempty. WAIVER_EXPIRED if both explicit evaluationDate and expiresOn are nonempty, parsable ISO dates, and expiry<evaluationDate; malformed nonempty date yields expired via ValueError; missing/empty date/expiry makes bool False. Waivers do not suppress any violations. Violations sorted via Violation dataclass ordering. repoContract={repoId,goal,noGoals,packageIds,sourceRef,generatedAuthority,readmeAuthority}; packageContracts=normalized package list. plan tuple={ruleId,subject,action:'fix violation before enabling as required check'} per violation. provenance={kind:'governance.repoGovernanceProvenance.v1',projectorVersion:'repo-governance/0.1.0',sourceRef,ruleDigest:digest(normalized bundle),snapshotDigest:digest(normalized snapshot)}. readmeGenerated is readme_text output. resultDigest=digest of {repoContract,packageContracts,violations,readmeGenerated,plan,provenance} before port serialization adds kind and passed.

error.description: Per-waiver ValueError parsing invalid nonempty dates is converted to WAIVER_EXPIRED; missing dates do not expire. Unsupported Python value shapes may raise other errors not covered by a top-level error envelope. No bundle-wide cryptographic accepted/adoption validation.

effect.description: Builds in-memory records and uses SHA256 and date.fromisoformat on explicit input strings; no wall clock, stdout, filesystem or network.
